claims.quantifiers: For every Boolean base P with U(P)<=2I(P), every integer d>=1, every parity-balanced fair half-activation tower T_d(P), every finite adaptive/pruned restriction tree querying only tower variables, and every common Boolean terminal core h on disjoint variables.
claims.statement: U(T_d(P))=2+2^-d(U(P)-2), I(T_d(P))=2+2^-d(I(P)-2), and the retained upper-set loss is at most 2I(T_d(P)).
claims.dependency: The general transfer theorem is self-contained. Its dense-nullity-two instantiation uses the prior B05 theorem at commit 97ee31ccf5dd58017837d3939ffb012af1ed034f.
limitations: fresh parity balancer at every level
does not control arbitrary changing coherent cores
